header.subtitle: Your projects and the ones shared with you. Files live on the server, so there is no folder to pick.

empty.title: No projects yet
empty.description: Create a project, or ask an owner to invite you to theirs.
empty.scopeDescription: Switch to “All” or create a new project.

loadError.title: Could not load projects
loadError.description: The server did not answer. Check your connection and try again: your projects are safe.

unavailable.title: Project not found or you do not have access
unavailable.message: The project may have been deleted, or it was never shared with you. If you are waiting for an invitation, contact the project owner.

panel.title: Access
panel.lead: Who works on the project and in which role. Everyone in a group gets the group's role.
panel.loadFailed: Could not load the access list.
panel.readOnly: Only the project owner can change access. Your role: {{role}}.
panel.orgRow: Organization members can read the project
panel.lockedHint: This row is not changed here

add.title: Add
add.hint: You cannot name an owner from this panel.
add.error: Search failed. Check your connection and try again.
add.none: No one found. A person must be a server user, a group must exist in an organization.

failure.last_owner: The project owner is not changed here.
failure.member_not_found: This person or group is not available to the project.
failure.not_found: Project not found or you do not have access.
failure.forbidden: Not enough permissions for this action.
failure.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
failure.csrf_failed: The session expired: refresh the page and try again.
failure.network: Cannot reach the server. Try again later.
failure.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again later.
